_comment: The ratified Entity__ word-sentinel grammar (Plan-UAT: __Version_/__Size_ word sentinels replace the earlier __At/__S glyph mnemonics). The deepseek version-vs-variant pair and the qwen 3.5-vs-35 pair are the INJECTIVITY-critical rows: each pair must render distinctly or two entities collapse onto one constant.

provenance.ref: deepseek@3.2 renders the version with the Version_ sentinel

mutation.description: carries the 3.2 token as a VERSION, half of the injectivity pair

provenance.ref: deepseek/v3.2 renders the variant with no sentinel

mutation.description: moves the same 3.2 token to the VARIANT slot, the other half of the pair

provenance.ref: qwen@3.5 sanitizes the dot to an underscore

mutation.description: uses a dotted version, half of the sanitize pair

provenance.ref: qwen@35 has no separator to preserve

mutation.description: removes the dot, which must NOT collide with the 3.5 rendering

provenance.ref: the fully-populated worked example from the ratified grammar

mutation.description: populates EVERY segment at once, pinning segment order and both word sentinels

provenance.ref: a variant that LOOKS like a size next to a real size segment

mutation.description: places a size-like token in the VARIANT slot beside a genuine #size, so only the Size_ sentinel distinguishes them
